The designer should add appropriate hole tolerances or fit designations (e.g., H7 or a defined clearance) to these functional features.","recommended_correction":"Add fit or tolerance callouts to dimensions D15 and D18 suitable for their fastener or locating function."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"NOTE : (English) # MATERIAL: M.S. # FINISH: I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT) # MACHINING: 3.2 # WEIGHT(Kg ): 1.85 kg"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D15","page":1,"quote":"4-⌀15"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D18","page":1,"quote":"4-⌀9"}],"comment":"Note N3 specifies an I.Z.B.P. (trivalent zinc) plating finish, but the plated holes (D15, D18) have no allowance for plating thickness in their dimensions or tolerances. Plating buildup will reduce the effective hole diameters and may prevent fasteners from fitting after finishing. The designer should either increase the hole sizes by the expected plating thickness or add a note specifying that hole dimensions apply after plating.","recommended_correction":"Account for plating thickness on holes D15 and D18 per note N3, either by adjusting the nominal sizes/tolerances or adding a post-plating dimension note."}]}
